Film 'Ramayana' Trailer Release Amidst Leak and Actor's Question

The trailer for the upcoming film 'Ramayana' was reportedly leaked online prior to its official release, with some outlets suggesting student protests may have caused a last-minute cancellation of a trailer launch event. Actor Ranbir Kapoor questioned whether Lord Ram was a god or a human during the film's shooting, a sentiment echoed by Kumar Vishwas. Critics have offered early reviews of the trailer, with some praising the portrayals of Ranbir Kapoor as Ram and Yash as Ravan. The film's promotional event in New Delhi also saw actress Rakul Preet Singh drawing attention.
